questions.notes: pct columns are per-sector raw samples; only seats are national. Parties below threshold (עמך ישראל, הציבור החרדי, נעם, הקהל, and others mentioned in the table footnote) recorded with 0 seats. The table includes separate sub-items from 'מפלגה אחרת' (צבע שחור, אחי, ישראל תחילה) which had 0.0% in all columns and are not included as separate rows. The undecided/not voting/blank percentages are shown per sector but not aggregated nationally in the main table.

extraction_notes: The PDF uses a complex layout with four sector columns (adult Jews, youth, Haredi, Arab) showing raw unweighted percentages, plus a mandates (seats) column that represents the national weighted allocation. Following the spec and the table footnote warning, I set pct to null for all parties since there is no national percentage column - only sector-specific raw percentages. The parties עמך ישראל and הציבור החרדי appear in the main table but with 0 mandates (below threshold). Additional parties (נעם, הקהל, and others) are mentioned in the footnote as sub-options of 'מפלגה אחרת' and shown with mostly 0.0% across sectors - I included נעם and הקהל as they are listed parties, though both received 0 mandates. The text mentions צבע שחור, אחי, and ישראל תחילה but all had 0.0% in every column so I did not create separate rows for them. Total seats sum to 120.
